one_liner: Plaid is a broad REST financial data API with a free Sandbox, a free Trial plan for new US/CA teams, and paid production access after approval. Core calls use a client_id and secret, and a separate OAuth service covers dashboard/MCP and consumer-report tokens.
auth_notes: The API reference pages show that requests carry a Plaid client_id (PLAID-CLIENT-ID header or body) and a secret (PLAID-SECRET header or body). Those are static credentials, so API_KEY. Plaid also runs an OAuth 2.0 service at /oauth/token that supports client_credentials, refresh_token and token-exchange grants, with scopes such as user:read and mcp:dashboard. The page says it is for consumer-report sharing, the Plaid Dashboard and other Plaid services. It is not the main route for the core product APIs, so API_KEY stays primary. Per-Item access_tokens from Link are not covered by the fetched pages.
access_notes: Sandbox is always free. New US/CA teams created on or after 2026-04-15 can get a free Trial plan with production APIs. Full Production needs approval (a few business days, with company and use-case info) and is paid. EU/UK customers can only get Custom plans.
blocker_notes: Sandbox and the Trial plan are self-serve. Scaling to full Production needs approval with company and use-case information, and each end user must complete Plaid Link. The Trial plan is limited to US/CA teams.
